game.name: Ziibiing
game.description: Ziibiing, 0.8.98: the Ojibwe village on the far continent, 50 N, where the maples run and the manoomin stands. Wigwams on the east bank of a river 34 paces wide, the sugar camp up the trail, the flint, red willow and obsidian banks a short paddle away. Ma'iingan lends one snare and Mitigwaabiike one tomahawk. Same world as ASHVALE: take the trail and the sea to Saltmere's new upstairs.
